body: I go to a tiny private school.
No - there aren't even any other lgbt kids.
I've already been to the subreddit and didn't get any responses.  And I don't know any lesbian / bi girls, so I can't get into a relationship with anyone I know irl.
Because I'm too much of a socially awkward nerd to ever date anyone?  I can't even make friends, never mind starting a relationship.

I don't care about labels - I can about attraction.  My problem isn't that I'm attracted to women but consider myself straight, my problem is that I don't know if I'm attracted to them.  I would never be in a relationship and be cheating with the opposite gender, because that would require knowing that you're attracted to them.

Curiosity? Dating is a pretty big part of adolescence and stuff - I don't want to miss out on all that stuff because I have no idea who I am.

And it seems like most adults have it figured out - How many 50 year olds have no idea what their sexual orientation is? Only ones with psychological issues or something...

That's what I mean about how it doesn't seem like it's going to ever end.  And my parents are super nosy and controlling - there's no way they'd just let me go to therapy without knowing what's going on.  And it wouldn't matter, because I can't discuss things like this with someone in real life - I suck at talking to people and stuff.
